description:
Condenser (components/condenser.rs:17) has only pressure: Pressure and target_outlet_quality: f64 (a bare f64 -- every other fraction in the layer is a uom Ratio; worth fixing while here). Zero geometry.

Part of op-dt3.17. The digital-twin widget layer must derive a component's on-screen size from its REAL dimensions; the engine crate forbids new physics, so the dimension must exist here in tampines.

DO NOT use HemSteamCv::get_volume() as a size -- it is the thermodynamic control volume, caller-supplied and unvalidated, conventionally a 1 m3 dummy (get_ref_vol() returns exactly 1.0 m3). It describes the fluid parcel, not the machine.

Prefer explicit named dimensions where shape matters to the drawing; a single nominal Volume is acceptable where only a rough size correlation is wanted. Document units and valid ranges in the doc comment per the workspace human-interface rule, and keep uom types.
title: tampines Condenser: add shell/envelope dimensions

description:
CoolingTower (components/cooling_tower.rs:19) has air_inlet: HumidAirState, water_inlet_temperature, water_flow_rate: VolumeRate, target_approach. Zero geometry.

Two traps: water_flow_rate is m3/s, a RATE not a volume; and air_inlet.volume is SpecificVolume (m3/kg), also not a size. Neither may be used for visual scale.

Cooling towers are the largest objects on a real plant and there is currently nothing to size them with.

Part of op-dt3.17. The digital-twin widget layer must derive a component's on-screen size from its REAL dimensions; the engine crate forbids new physics, so the dimension must exist here in tampines.

Prefer explicit named dimensions where shape matters to the drawing; a single nominal Volume is acceptable where only a rough size correlation is wanted. Document units and valid ranges in the doc comment per the workspace human-interface rule, and keep uom types.

description: Per the 2026-08-11 CLAUDE.md literature rule (commit 0857f5ea): the njoy-outram-park-fork thermal-scattering work cites ENDF-102 semantics in doc comments (src/endf/interp.rs law table 0.5.2; src/thermr/mf7.rs MF7 MT2/MT4 LT/LI record layouts, 7.2/7.4), but ENDF-102 is not in crates/kovan-literature/CATALOGUE.md (checked 2026-08-11, no match for 'ENDF-102' or 'formats manual'). The implementation itself was cross-checked against upstream NJOY2016 Fortran (endf.f90 terp1, thermr.f90 rdelas/calcem - source code, in-repo at the porting reference, not a publication) and against the raw ENDF/B-VIII.0 graphite tapes (data, exempt from the rule), so no uncited formula was taken from a publication from model memory; but the ENDF-102 section references in doc comments currently point at nothing in the archive. TODO: obtain the ENDF-102 manual PDF (CSEWG/BNL publication, e.g. the ENDF-6 Formats Manual, latest revision), decide access tier from its own copyright page (US national-lab report - likely open, but VERIFY, unsure means proprietary), kovan lit import, add to CATALOGUE.md, and confirm the section numbers cited in njoy doc comments against the actual document.
title: kovan-literature: catalogue ENDF-102 (ENDF-6 Formats Manual) - cited by njoy thermal-scattering code, not in archive
